title: Compare two alignments
description: Compare Hillside access and Contour alternative on length, grade and cost, then make the alternative the active road.

setup.goal: Read a comparison of two roads against a baseline and switch to the other road.
audience: Forest road designers new to PGMaps
access: None: the lesson opens the synthetic training project, which needs no sign-in and no data download.
setup.startingScreen: The road designer on the Hillside access training project, at station 0+000 with the cross-section shown.
limitations: The readings are those of the synthetic training terrain and the Hillside access roads as shipped.

check.description: the detail pane shows the comparison

overlay.title: Open the comparison
overlay.body: Select Compare all beside the road selector. The detail pane lists every road in the project.

overlay.title: Check the baseline
overlay.body: Compared with names the baseline, Hillside access. The other road’s differences are measured against it.

overlay.title: Read the trade-off
overlay.body: Contour alternative is longer, 1,474 m against 1,429 m, but its steepest grade is lower, 8.5% against 10%. Incomplete cost means the table cannot rank these roads on cost.

check.description: Contour alternative is the active road

overlay.title: Select the alternative
overlay.body: Select Contour alternative in the table to make it the active road.

overlay.title: Check the active road
overlay.body: Road name now reads Contour alternative · training, and its profile and sections are on screen.
